messages.author: c11705b20117cf76
messages.subject: range/state list in time stratified analysis
parts:
Dear Nick and group members:
  Hi! I want to know state/range probabilities at each node and I encounter problems when I try to get it, after I run a time stratified analysis with three timeperiods.
  Although I get a file that contained probabilities and node number, but failed to get state/range list. It seems that there are 64 state/range in "res" but it would be 168 possible state/range after simulation, using 7 areas with max_range_size=3. So, my question is how to know respective state/range list about my analysis?  I think it is possible that time stratified analysis reduce number of possible state/range but I do not know how to extract this lists. 
  I am looking forward to any advice. 
 THANKS!
 Best wishes!
ZJ

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] range/state list in time stratified analysis
parts:
Hi -- I don't really understand the question.  When you do:

numstates_from_numareas(numareas=7, maxareas=3,include_null_range=TRUE)

...you get 64 states/ranges, not 168.

If the state space changes between time strata, the analysis keeps track of all possible states, and assigns 0 probability to the disallowed states, so the matrix of states/ranges stays the same size in the output for all time periods.

Cheers,
Nick
